# Idira Partner Integration Development Kits

> Development kits for building and certifying a technology integration with the Palo Alto Networks
> Idira Identity Security Platform. Seventeen kits across nine workflows, each with a development
> guide (one Preview kit's guide is not yet published) and the certification checklist the integration will be graded against. Published so a
> partner — or a partner's AI agent — can drive the build without a review cycle per question.

Read `journey.md` before anything else: it is the only file that states the five stages and the gates.
`decision-guide.md` then routes what you are building to the correct integration-request-form option
and the correct kit. Each kit's certification checklist is published deliberately, so it can be read
during the build rather than discovered at submission.

These guides describe APIs in prose and worked examples. No kit ships an OpenAPI document, GraphQL
SDL, or XSD, so the examples do not fully determine every schema. Where a field's type or permitted
values are not stated, ask rather than infer — `AGENTS.md` has the specific cases.

Content is licensed CC BY 4.0. Feeding it into partner tooling, retrieval indexes, and coding agents
is explicitly permitted.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Machine entry point — read order, stop rules, permitted use
- [The Partner Integration Journey](docs/journey.md): The five stages, the gates, and what is graded
- [Which Integration Do I Select?](docs/decision-guide.md): Routes what you build to a form option and a kit
- [Development Kits Index](docs/index.md): Catalog of every workflow and kit, with status

## Cross-cutting requirements

- [Telemetry reference](docs/telemetry-reference.md): The mandatory `x-cybr-telemetry` header — transform, per-kit `IntegrationType` registry, reference code in five languages, test vectors
- [Idira product name crosswalk](docs/naming-crosswalk.md): Current Idira names against CyberArk-era and legacy names, and which names deliberately did not change
- [Marketplace listing standards](docs/marketplace-standards.md): What listing content must look like
- [Joint Solution Brief standards](docs/jsb-standards.md): Standards for a joint solution brief

## Discovery

- [Discovery decision guide](docs/discovery/decision-guide.md): Choose between the four Discovery kits
- [Privileged Accounts](docs/discovery/privileged-accounts/development-guide.md): Push discovered privileged accounts into Idira ([checklist](docs/discovery/privileged-accounts/certification-checklist.md))
- [AI Agents](docs/discovery/ai-agents/development-guide.md): Push discovered AI agents into Idira ([checklist](docs/discovery/ai-agents/certification-checklist.md))
- [Machine Identities](docs/discovery/machine-identities/development-guide.md): Push discovered workloads into Idira ([checklist](docs/discovery/machine-identities/certification-checklist.md))
- [Secrets](docs/discovery/secrets/development-guide.md): Push discovered secrets into Idira ([checklist](docs/discovery/secrets/certification-checklist.md))

## EPM

- [EPM decision guide](docs/epm/decision-guide.md): Choose between the three EPM kits
- [Audit Events](docs/epm/audit-events/development-guide.md): Stream EPM audit events into a partner platform ([checklist](docs/epm/audit-events/certification-checklist.md))
- [Ticketing — JIT Admin Elevation](docs/epm/ticketing-jit/development-guide.md): Gate JIT elevation through a partner ticketing approval workflow ([checklist](docs/epm/ticketing-jit/certification-checklist.md))
- [SOC Response](docs/epm/soc-response/development-guide.md): Trigger endpoint privilege containment from an XDR detection or SOAR playbook ([checklist](docs/epm/soc-response/certification-checklist.md))

## Secrets Management

- [Secrets Management decision guide](docs/secrets-management/decision-guide.md): Choose between the four secrets-retrieval paths
- [Secrets Manager SaaS](docs/secrets-management/secrets-manager-saas/development-guide.md): Retrieve secrets from Secrets Manager SaaS ([checklist](docs/secrets-management/secrets-manager-saas/certification-checklist.md))
- [Credential Provider](docs/secrets-management/credential-provider/development-guide.md): Agent-based local secret retrieval ([checklist](docs/secrets-management/credential-provider/certification-checklist.md))
- [Central Credential Provider](docs/secrets-management/central-credential-provider/development-guide.md): Agentless REST secret retrieval ([checklist](docs/secrets-management/central-credential-provider/certification-checklist.md))
- [Secrets Manager Self-Hosted](docs/secrets-management/secrets-manager-self-hosted/development-guide.md): Retrieve secrets from a self-hosted deployment ([checklist](docs/secrets-management/secrets-manager-self-hosted/certification-checklist.md))
- [Secrets Manager integration-guide template](docs/secrets-management/integration-guide-templates/secrets-manager.md): Draft template for the integration guide a certified Secrets Manager integration publishes
- [Credential Provider integration-guide template](docs/secrets-management/integration-guide-templates/credential-provider.md): Draft template for the integration guide a certified CP or CCP integration publishes

## Workload Identity

- [Workload Identity decision guide](docs/workload-identity/decision-guide.md): One kit, so this guide tests whether the integration belongs in this workflow rather than in Secrets Management or Discovery — establishing an identity and using one to fetch a secret are different integrations. Also resolves the `SWA` acronym collision with the unrelated Secure Web Application Connectors Framework
- [SWA Federation](docs/workload-identity/swa-federation/development-guide.md): Establish SPIFFE identity for workloads your platform runs, routes, or hosts, so they authenticate to Idira with a short-lived attested SVID instead of a distributed secret. **Preview** — not a certifiable path yet, and the step-level federation exchange is deliberately not published: confirm it rather than reconstructing it from SPIFFE or SPIRE material ([checklist](docs/workload-identity/swa-federation/certification-checklist.md))

## Identity Access Management

- [Identity Governance & Provisioning checklist](docs/identity-access-management/identity-governance/certification-checklist.md): Provision, reconcile, and certify identities and entitlements in Idira from a partner IGA platform — SCIM provisioning, entitlement read, role membership, PAM objects. **Preview** — not a certifiable path yet, and the development guide is not yet published: build from the Idira documentation each checklist row cites rather than reconstructing a guide

## Other workflows

- [Audit Service — SIEM Integration](docs/audit-service/siem-integration/development-guide.md): Stream Idira identity and privileged-access audit events into a partner platform ([checklist](docs/audit-service/siem-integration/certification-checklist.md))
- [Credential Rotation — CPM REST API Plugin](docs/credential-rotation/cpm-rest-api/development-guide.md): A CPM plugin that rotates credentials for a target application ([checklist](docs/credential-rotation/cpm-rest-api/certification-checklist.md))
- [Identity Response Actions](docs/identity-response/response-actions/development-guide.md): Trigger identity, session, credential, and access-policy response actions from an XDR/SIEM/SOAR platform ([checklist](docs/identity-response/response-actions/certification-checklist.md))
- [PSM Web Connection Component](docs/psm-connectors/web-connection-component/development-guide.md): Package a connection component so PSM can broker and record a session to a partner web application. Browser automation, not REST — the telemetry requirement does not apply ([checklist](docs/psm-connectors/web-connection-component/certification-checklist.md))
